method.first_pass: Classified route claims and compared public descriptions, chapter maps, citations, readiness language, and prerequisites with canonical manuscript inputs, the notebook bridge manifest, and separately governed software authority.
method.second_pass: Re-read every corrected route adversarially for causal alternatives, counterexamples, omitted chapters, mutable-source leakage, unsupported completeness, and unmeasured readiness or instructional claims.

claims.statement: Volume III is available as provisional source material whose experimental, inverse-dynamics, muscle, tissue, clinical, and coaching interpretations remain separated by an explicit evidence ladder.
authority_limits: Manuscript availability is not empirical, clinical, diagnostic, or coaching validation.
Instrumentation constrains only declared quantities and does not establish whole-model fidelity.
assumptions: Readers follow the declared observation-to-inference evidence ladder.
uncertainty: Application-specific anatomy, parameters, coordinate conventions, measurements, and validation remain outside this route audit.
falsifiers: A route statement describes inferred tissue or muscle quantities as directly measured without instrumentation and identification evidence.
audience_limits: Not clinical, diagnostic, rehabilitation, coaching, or design authority.

findings.rationale: The prior route blurred chapter availability, notebook existence, and model fidelity; the correction pins source bytes, states scaffold limits, and bounds biological inferences.

counterexamples: Motion capture alone cannot identify muscle force or tissue stress even when the manuscript and notebook exist.
alternative_mechanisms: Equivalent kinematics may arise from different muscle recruitment, passive tissue, or contact assumptions.
remaining_disagreements: Which protocols provide sufficient identifiability for each chapter model remains application-specific.

claims.statement: Volume II is an available provisional manuscript whose local transverse-control constructions require declared phase, mode, model, controller, and disturbance assumptions.
authority_limits: The framing organizes established techniques; it is not asserted as a new general theorem.
The canonical Complete Golf Swing title does not establish complete modeling or evidence.
assumptions: Local transverse coordinates and phase are well-defined on the analyzed domain.
uncertainty: No route-level empirical golf or controller-deployment validation is claimed.
falsifiers: A claimed invariant funnel fails under a disturbance inside its declared verified set.
audience_limits: Not a controller certification, safety case, or player-specific prescription.

findings.rationale: The route needed an explicit publication state, immutable authority links, notebook limits, and a boundary around the canonical completeness-bearing chapter title.

counterexamples: A phase coordinate can cease to be monotone or defined at a reset, invalidating a transverse construction.
alternative_mechanisms: Apparent recovery can arise from feedback, passive mechanics, hybrid dynamics, or selection effects.
remaining_disagreements: Application-specific verified invariant sets and empirical comparisons remain unavailable.

claims.statement: Volume IV is available as a provisional hypothesis-building manuscript, not validated neural mechanism, clinical account, human-performance model, or deployable robot specification.
authority_limits: Conceptual comparison is not an empirical benchmark.
Biological inspiration does not establish causal neural mechanism or deployment readiness.
assumptions: Readers distinguish model exposition from observations and causal evidence.
uncertainty: Neural, behavioral, timing, clinical, and robot-deployment validation remain outside this audit.
falsifiers: Empirical timing or perturbation data are inconsistent with a chapter mechanism under its declared model.
audience_limits: Not medical, rehabilitation, coaching, human-performance, or robot deployment authority.

findings.rationale: The prior route omitted canonical chapter 7B and amplified real-time, demonstration, benchmark, and deployability language without validation.

counterexamples: Similar behavior can arise from feedback, passive mechanics, learned policies, or task constraints without the proposed neural architecture.
alternative_mechanisms: Parallel computation, internal models, impedance regulation, and environmental dynamics can explain overlapping observations.
remaining_disagreements: The route does not adjudicate among neural mechanisms or quantify predictive performance.

claims.statement: The book landing page distinguishes two textbook collections, the governed technical monograph, provisional manuscript routes, scaffolded notebooks, and separately governed software capability.
authority_limits: Navigation availability does not establish instructional completeness or scientific validation.
Software readiness must be checked on the governed tools route.
A computational publication and matching digests do not establish textbook completion, independent scientific confirmation, or human validation.
assumptions: The reviewed route set and canonical sources remain byte-identical to their declared digests.
uncertainty: Chapter-level web rendering and executable notebook validation remain incomplete.
Independent scientific review and participant-level validation of the proximal-to-distal mechanisms remain open.
falsifiers: A linked route or canonical source is absent at the reviewed revision.
The monograph source manifest, chapter count, or PDF metadata disagrees with the public Books description.
audience_limits: For navigation and research orientation, not certification or instruction sufficiency.

findings.rationale: The landing page now distinguishes the two textbooks, governed technical monograph, scaffolded notebooks, source state, and separate software authority without promoting computational evidence to human validation.

counterexamples: A notebook link can exist while its imports fail or outputs are numerically wrong.
Prominent placement can make a computational monograph appear empirically or instructionally validated even when its limits are stated.
alternative_mechanisms: Readers can use canonical LaTeX even when a web chapter or executable notebook is unavailable.
Readers can discover the monograph through search, the article catalog, or direct source links without using the Books hub.
remaining_disagreements: No course-completion or learner-outcome evidence is available.
No user-study evidence establishes that the new placement improves discovery, and no participant evidence validates the modeled mechanisms in people.

claims.statement: The roadmap supplies bounded prerequisite suggestions and canonical chapter counts without unmeasured reading-time, mastery, completion, or prerequisite-waiver claims.
authority_limits: Chapter counts establish source inclusion only.
Suggested order is not a validated curriculum or learning-outcome guarantee.
assumptions: Substantive chapters are chapter inputs in main.tex, excluding glossary, further-reading, and nomenclature inputs.
uncertainty: Reading time, instructional sufficiency, and learner outcomes have not been measured.
falsifiers: A canonical main.tex chapter input is missing from the stated substantive count.
audience_limits: For route planning; not academic credit, professional qualification, or prerequisite waiver.

findings.rationale: The prior roadmap published unsupported hour ranges, mastery and no-background claims, stale chapter counts, and completion language despite scaffolded notebooks.

counterexamples: Readers with the same background can require materially different time because proof checking and reproduction depth differ.
alternative_mechanisms: Readers can enter by application area rather than consume volumes sequentially.
remaining_disagreements: Measured workload and assessment evidence remain unavailable, so quantitative schedules stay publication-blocked.

claims.statement: Volume I maps all ten canonical substantive chapters and bounds exactness to instantaneous input superposition at fixed state and mode under the declared intervention contract.
authority_limits: Instantaneous control-effect superposition does not establish finite-horizon trajectory superposition or reachability.
A proposed stability-optimality relationship is not asserted as a global equivalence.
assumptions: The system is control-affine and evaluated at the same state, time, and hybrid mode for the input decomposition.
uncertainty: Global equivalence, cross-mode behavior, and application validation require separate proof or experiment.
falsifiers: Compared input effects at the same state and mode fail the declared affine decomposition.
audience_limits: Not a global controllability theorem, verified controller, or empirical biomechanics conclusion.

findings.rationale: The prior map omitted canonical chapters 3B and 9 and used unbounded exactness and unification language.

counterexamples: Constant additive drift can shift finite-horizon reachable states while instantaneous input differences remain affine.
alternative_mechanisms: Observed local convergence can follow feedback, trajectory selection, or a restricted metric rather than a universal duality.
remaining_disagreements: No global stability-optimality equivalence or application-wide empirical validation is available.
